headwords: ba mươi chưa phải là Tết

flags.why: This idiom describes hardship and an unsettled life, rather than a literal count of sinking and floating ([dictionary](https://thuvien.vietnamthuquan.eu/TacPham/tu-dien-tieng-viet-1713/chuong-2)).
The everyday shortened numeral meaning 'thirty-five' is missing.
flags.fix: Add: numeral [colloquial] | thirty-five; ex: Cái này giá ba lăm nghìn. = This costs thirty-five thousand dong.

flags.why: The sense is explicitly a rude insult but lacks a derogatory warning.
The example explains what people called the soldiers instead of directly using the word to describe them.
flags.fix: Ông ấy từng là lính ba que. = He used to be a 'ba que' soldier.

flags.why: The example defines the institution instead of showing the term in use.
flags.fix: Ban Bí thư đã họp sáng nay. = The Secretariat met this morning.

flags.why: 'Ban khen' means to commend someone below one's rank, rather than a separate sense 'to congratulate' ([dictionary](https://tudientv.com/?t=ban+khen)).
'Banh đũa' is mainly the Southern name for this game ([regional names](https://thuvientrochoi.com/dong-dao.html)).
The example defines the perianth instead of showing the term in use.
flags.fix: Cô ấy dùng kính lúp quan sát bao hoa. = She used a magnifying glass to examine the perianth.
